roles.label: Scout
roles.contribution: Reveals safe routes and reads distant signals
roles.ability: Move can reveal an extra zone.

roles.label: Medic
roles.contribution: Restores the crew and turns setbacks into another chance
roles.ability: Rest and Help recover more morale.

roles.label: Carrier
roles.contribution: Protects recovered relics and interprets their needs

roles.label: Guard
roles.contribution: Stabilizes crossings and protects the crew's way home

characters.name: Signal Cartographer
characters.fantasy: Hear the path before anyone else can see it.
characters.emotionalPromise: Your attention turns uncertainty into a route the crew can trust.
characters.voice: Precise, observant, quietly reassuring; speaks in bearings, echoes, and possibilities.

identity.silhouette: Tall upright figure with a large square shoulder signal array, paired antennae, and a low mineral satchel.
identity.face: Mature angular face, straight brows, blue-gray eyes, long nose, clean-shaven jaw.
identity.hair: Short dark-brown hair swept high and back with closely cropped sides.
identity.proportions: Tall lean adult with long legs and restrained, attentive posture.
signatureEquipment: square left-shoulder signal array with cyan display
paired antennae rising behind the left shoulder
rectangular mineral satchel at the left hip
avoid: moving the satchel to the opposite hip

characters.name: Field Mender
characters.fantasy: Keep one more light alive when the expedition begins to fray.
characters.emotionalPromise: Care becomes a visible, consequential form of courage.
characters.voice: Warm, economical, and gently stubborn; names what can still be repaired.

identity.silhouette: Short broad figure with a rounded cross-body field case, rolled blanket collar, and three luminous repair vials at the right hip.
identity.face: Older broad face with warm dark-brown skin, high cheekbones, a soft square jaw, and a narrow scar through the left eyebrow.
identity.hair: Close-cropped silver curls with a clean rounded hairline.
identity.proportions: Short, broad, sturdy adult with grounded feet and relaxed shoulders.
signatureEquipment: rounded moss-green field case worn cross-body
three oxide-green luminous repair vials at the right hip

characters.name: Relic Tender
characters.fantasy: Carry something impossible without treating it like a prize.
characters.emotionalPromise: Stewardship makes discovery feel tender, strange, and earned.
characters.voice: Patient, tactile, and quietly awed; describes weight, warmth, pulse, and trust.

identity.silhouette: Medium-height figure with a long split tunic, cloth relic sling across the chest, and one protected mineral seed held at the sternum.
identity.face: Young adult oval face, warm light-brown skin, large dark eyes, soft straight brows, and a small rounded chin.
identity.hair: Medium-brown hair center-parted into a low ponytail with two short face-framing strands.
identity.proportions: Medium-height slender adult with protective inward arm shapes and an unhurried stance.
signatureEquipment: gray protective fabric sling across the chest

characters.name: Routekeeper
characters.fantasy: Hold the way home open while the world argues otherwise.
characters.emotionalPromise: Responsibility becomes a calm, visible act of protection.
characters.voice: Steady, spare, and protective; speaks in crossings, anchors, and promises kept.

identity.silhouette: Tall figure under a long asymmetrical charcoal mantle, with a square gold route lantern held high in the right hand.
identity.face: Adult long oval face, warm olive skin, strong straight brows, narrow brown eyes, and a squared chin.
identity.hair: Dark-brown hair center-parted and tied into a low short ponytail.
identity.proportions: Tall athletic adult with long legs, broad mantle, and grounded stance.
signatureEquipment: round cyan route instrument at the right hip
